description: DEP-06 §Enter: the accused operator never signs a DisputeEnter on its own ledger, and a fork a node opened on a ledger it operates is void. `proof_cases`: node `us` holds a ledger whose current operator is `operator` and receives a VERIFIED fraud proof accusing `accused`; expect whether it enters a dispute (opens a fork) and how many updates it signs doing so (its DisputeEnter). A node enters only when the proof accuses the ledger's current operator and `us` is neither the accused nor the operator. `fork_cases`: a fork record held at startup; `fate` is `void` (a fork of a ledger we operate: never published, never yielded), `retire` (superseded by a QuorumBegin on the base past the fork point: not republished; an expiry dispute under a ruleset where only a confirmed spend ends it is not judged here and stays `publish`), `publish`, or `not_ours` (another member's fork, or not Disputed/Armed). Keys are names; `null` means the record is not held. From the signet soak, 2026-11-19/20: ref4, operator of 5effb9e8, forked its own ledger at 432509 on a QuorumExpired proof against itself and later signed the main chain's 432510; a restart republished the fork and its members proved Equivocation.
